subject: Renewal + Top-up: remit pathway & collector switch for Rivermark

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@rivermark.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@rivermark.com
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + top-up - remit / collector question

Thanks Grace — we reviewed the renewal proposal and want to proceed with the 150% capacity top-up on the existing term. Before we pull the PO trigger for finance, two items to clarify so we can route payment correctly:

- Remit destination: our treasury group has split collectors across EMEA / US. Which remit entity will Redwood invoice for this top-up?
- Net terms: can the renewed contract carry the same net 45 we had on the pilot, or will it be standard net 30 for this commit?
- Tax: our tax team asked for an updated W-9 for your billing entity.

We'll prepare a PO when those are confirmed. I can loop in our treasury mailbox if that's helpful.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Director, Strategic Procurement
Rivermark Technologies


From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@rivermark.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 8 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + top-up - remit / collector question

Asha — great to hear you want to move forward, and thanks for the clearly scoped asks. Quick answers below and next steps so your finance team can issue the PO:

1) Remit destination: Redwood will invoice the US billing entity by default (Redwood Inference, Inc.). If you need the invoice routed to a specific collector account, we can add the collector account code to the invoice header — pls confirm the collector email/address you want on file.

2) Net terms: for this renewal + committed top-up the standard is net 30; however, we can preserve net 45 for the existing pilot customers as a one-time exception tied to the annual renewal (deal: RIV-RW-7421). We'd need approval from RevOps; copying KarthiK to coordinate.

3) W-9: attached is our current W-9 and legal billing entity.

If you can share the PO number and whether payment will be made to the US collector or to an AP mailbox in the EU, we'll finalize the invoice template and send a DocuSign for the amendment.

Next steps: Karthik — can you confirm the netterms exception process and whether we should route the PO to our billing collector or issue under the RevOps-approved exception? Marissa — once Karthik confirms, please prepare the amendment + DocuSign link for Asha.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Looping in RevOps intake. Quick update for the thread:

- Net terms exception (pilot-preserve-net45): acceptable for this renewal as a one-off; need written approval from RevOps manager and finance sign-off on aging metrics. I'll submit the exception request today referencing deal RIV-RW-7421.
- Remit routing: we can add a collector code to the invoice header; if Rivermark wants treasury@rivermark.com as the remit contact we'll annotate that in the invoice metadata. Note: adding a non-US collector may create additional tax/currency handling — Marissa, can you check whether invoicing to an EU-located collector requires an EORI/VAT ID on their PO?
- Document bundle: once Po is received, request that Asha attach the PO (PDF) and the AP remit mailbox. We'll then generate: (1) amendment with net45 language, (2) invoice template, (3) DocuSign link.

Marissa: please draft the amendment + attach the PO placeholder and DocuSign. Asha — when you have the PO file and remit mailbox I can expedite RevOps approval.
